parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/MusicShareKit/Tests/MusicShareKitTests/RequestLineAuthFeatureTests.swift`. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.727) between `returnsTrueWhenFlagEnabled` and `overrideFalseOverridesFlag` is expected in a test file: the two methods are exercising distinct flag-override scenarios for the same feature under test, and their near-duplicate shape reflects the standard arrange-act-assert pattern repeated across test cases rather than accidental duplication. Merging or extracting these test methods would obscure the distinct intent of each scenario and couple test-fixture logic into shared production code.
